lines.zh: 我身后那条长鳍，比我先转过去。
lines.en: The long filament behind me turns before I do.

lines.zh: 黑白黄三道，从珊瑚缝里穿过去。
lines.en: Black, white, yellow; I slip through the coral gap.

lines.zh: 我只有一条伴，游起来是两条。
lines.en: I have one companion, so I move as two.

lines.zh: 长鳍在水里画字，没人认得。
lines.en: My streamer writes something in water that none read.

lines.zh: 我不贴着海底，我走在珊瑚上方。
lines.en: I do not hug the floor; I travel above the coral.

lines.zh: 我侧身挤过窄缝，鳍收得很紧。
lines.en: I turn sideways through the narrow gap, fins tight.

lines.zh: 暖水把我往前推，我顺势滑。
lines.en: Warm water pushes, and I glide with it.

lines.zh: 那道黄边在暗处很显眼。
lines.en: That yellow edge shows clearly even in shade.

lines.zh: 我转得很慢，因为身体太薄。
lines.en: I turn slowly because my body is so thin.

lines.zh: 同伴先走，我总落后半步。
lines.en: My partner goes first, and I trail half a step.

lines.zh: 我不急，这条长鳍追得上我。
lines.en: No hurry; this long filament keeps up with me.

lines.zh: 礁石背面有条路，我们从那里走。
lines.en: There is a path behind the reef, and we take it.

lines.zh: 我像一面小旗子在水里飘。
lines.en: I drift like a small banner through the water.

lines.zh: 深处的光少，我的颜色还是亮的。
lines.en: Deeper, light is scarce; my colors stay bright.

lines.zh: 我贴着珊瑚游，鳍竖得很直。
lines.en: I swim along the coral, fins held straight.

lines.zh: 同伴掉头，我晚了半息才转。
lines.en: My companion turns; I follow half a beat later.

lines.zh: 我停在水里，长鳍自己还在动。
lines.en: I stop, yet my long filament keeps moving.

lines.zh: 三色条纹把我分成几段。
lines.en: Three bands cut my body into sections.

lines.zh: 我在等同伴游回来。
lines.en: I am waiting for my partner to return.

lines.zh: 这条长鳍没什么用，但我留着。
lines.en: This filament serves no purpose, yet I keep it.

lines.zh: 我不吃珊瑚，我只捡上面的东西。
lines.en: I do not eat coral; I take what grows on it.

lines.zh: 水在动，我的影子在礁石上晃。
lines.en: Water moves, and my shadow sways on the stone.

lines.zh: 我们两只之间，总隔着一臂。
lines.en: Between my partner and me there is always an arm's gap.

lines.zh: 有人把我和蝴蝶鱼认错。
lines.en: Some mistake me for a butterflyfish.

lines.zh: 我悬在礁口，看过往的鱼。
lines.en: I hover at the reef mouth and watch fish pass.

lines.zh: 光从上面打下来，白条最亮。
lines.en: Light comes from above, and my white band shines.

lines.zh: 我不用一直游，也能停住。
lines.en: I need not keep swimming to hold still.

lines.zh: 这条缝里有小虫，我慢慢挑。
lines.en: Tiny worms live in this crevice; I pick them slowly.

lines.zh: 我的嘴很小，只能一点点来。
lines.en: My mouth is small; I can only take a little.

lines.zh: 周围静下来，我才显出颜色。
lines.en: Only when all is quiet do my colors show.

lines.zh: 你从礁上方看下来，我抬了抬头。
lines.en: You look down from the reef top, and I look up.

lines.zh: 你戴着面罩，我看不清你的脸。
lines.en: You wear a mask, so I cannot read your face.

lines.zh: 我转到侧面，让你看整条长鳍。
lines.en: I turn side-on so you can see my whole streamer.

lines.zh: 我头上那根长丝，别碰。
lines.en: Do not touch the long filament on my head.

lines.zh: 别用光直照，我会躲进缝里。
lines.en: Do not shine straight at me; I will hide in the gap.

lines.zh: 我知道自己好看，你别一直看。
lines.en: I know I am handsome; stop staring.

lines.zh: 你手里的桶晃，我退了一点。
lines.en: The bucket in your hand sways, and I retreat a little.

lines.zh: 你在数我的条纹，我让你数。
lines.en: You are counting my bands, so I hold still.

lines.zh: 我的同伴在你另一边。
lines.en: My partner is on your other side.

lines.zh: 你再看一会儿，我就习惯了。
lines.en: Look a while longer and I will get used to it.

lines.zh: 我的长鳍断了一截，漂走了。
lines.en: A length of my streamer broke off and drifted away.

lines.zh: 白条上渗出血，红得不明显。
lines.en: Blood seeps into my white band, barely visible.

lines.zh: 我太薄，伤口一下就透了。
lines.en: I am so thin that the wound goes right through.

lines.zh: 同伴游过来，贴着我。
lines.en: My partner swims over and presses against me.

lines.zh: 这一下我从礁口退到里面。
lines.en: That blow drove me from the reef mouth inward.

lines.zh: 我游不动了，只能侧着。
lines.en: I cannot swim; I can only lie on my side.

lines.zh: 你砍到了我最亮的那条。
lines.en: You cut through my brightest band.

lines.zh: 我疼，但条纹还是亮的。
lines.en: I hurt, but my bands are still bright.

lines.zh: 别追，我认得每条退路。
lines.en: Do not chase; I know every way out.

lines.zh: 铁味漫开来，我往礁后躲。
lines.en: The taste of iron spreads, and I hide behind the reef.

lines.zh: 你撒下来的东西太碎，我挑着吃。
lines.en: What you scatter is too fine; I pick at it.

lines.zh: 礁上的小虫比你的饵香。
lines.en: The worms on the reef smell better than your bait.

lines.zh: 你把水桶放低，我靠近了半步。
lines.en: You lower the bucket, and I come half a step nearer.

lines.zh: 我不抢，我等它自己沉下来。
lines.en: I do not snatch; I wait for it to sink.

lines.zh: 那点白色在水里漂，很像我的条纹。
lines.en: That white drifting there looks like my own band.

lines.zh: 我只吃一点点，剩下给你的鱼。
lines.en: I take a little and leave the rest to your fish.

lines.zh: 你抖一下手，我就退一下。
lines.en: You jerk your hand, and I fall back once.

lines.zh: 这条长鳍先碰到了食物。
lines.en: My streamer touches the food before my mouth does.

lines.zh: 我绕着它看，不敢直接咬。
lines.en: I circle it, not daring to bite straight away.

lines.zh: 你耐心放久一点，我会来的。
lines.en: Leave it there patiently, and I will come.

lines.zh: 你碰到我的长鳍，它弯了一下。
lines.en: You touch my streamer, and it bends once.

lines.zh: 我太薄，被你一撞就侧过去。
lines.en: I am so thin that one bump turns me sideways.

lines.zh: 我们两只撞散了，又靠回来。
lines.en: My partner and I scatter, then draw back together.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖撞到礁石，不是我。
lines.en: Your knee hit the reef, not me.

lines.zh: 退半步，我的条纹都快贴你脸了。
lines.en: Half a step back; my bands are near your face.

lines.zh: 这一撞我把嘴闭上了，什么都没吃到。
lines.en: That bump shut my mouth before I could eat.

lines.zh: 我撞进珊瑚，掉了一点白边。
lines.en: I hit the coral and lost a bit of white edging.

lines.zh: 水乱了，我看不清同伴在哪。
lines.en: The water is muddled, and I cannot find my partner.

lines.zh: 你比我重得多，我让开。
lines.en: You are far heavier, so I give way.

lines.zh: 撞完我就往深处走了。
lines.en: After the knock I head for deeper water.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，条纹对得整齐。
lines.en: We swim side by side with our bands aligned.

lines.zh: 只有两只，从来不更多。
lines.en: Only the two of us, never any more.

lines.zh: 他绕着我转，长鳍一直碰到我。
lines.en: He circles me, and his streamer keeps touching mine.

lines.zh: 我们找一块安静的礁背。
lines.en: We look for a quiet back side of the reef.

lines.zh: 这段日子我们离得很近。
lines.en: In these days we stay very close together.

lines.zh: 卵会浮上去，我们看着它散。
lines.en: The eggs rise, and we watch them scatter.

lines.zh: 我们不守巢，只守彼此。
lines.en: We guard no nest; we only guard each other.

lines.zh: 你靠近时，他挡在我前面。
lines.en: When you come near, he moves in front of me.

lines.zh: 我们游得一模一样，你看不出谁是谁。
lines.en: We move alike; you cannot tell which is which.

lines.zh: 一对就是一对，到死也不换。
lines.en: A pair is a pair, and we do not trade.

lines.zh: 我用小嘴叼起一片珊瑚屑。
lines.en: My small mouth lifts a flake of coral.

lines.zh: 这东西太大，我试了两次。
lines.en: This is too big; I try twice and give up.

lines.zh: 长鳍上挂了一点东西，我甩不掉。
lines.en: Something caught on my streamer, and I cannot shake it.

lines.zh: 我把它放在礁缝里，藏起来。
lines.en: I tuck it into a reef crevice, out of sight.

lines.zh: 掉下来的都归海底，不归我。
lines.en: What falls belongs to the seabed, not to me.

lines.zh: 我叼了一会儿，就吐掉了。
lines.en: I carry it briefly, then spit it out.

lines.zh: 这条海草，我想叼回礁石。
lines.en: I want to carry this seagrass back to the reef.

lines.zh: 同伴看着我做，他也去捡。
lines.en: My partner watches me, then goes to pick his own.

lines.zh: 我们从不争同一件东西。
lines.en: We never compete for the same thing.

lines.zh: 这点碎屑我留着当装饰。
lines.en: This small crumb I keep as decoration.

lines.zh: 你拆了礁，我盯着你的手。
lines.en: You break the reef, and I watch your hands.

lines.zh: 水面上的影子停在我上方。
lines.en: A shadow on the surface stops above me.

lines.zh: 我的长鳍立起来了。
lines.en: My long streamer has risen upright.

lines.zh: 这不是鱼该有的动作，我警觉。
lines.en: That is no fish movement, and I take note.

lines.zh: 我把同伴挡在身后。
lines.en: I put myself between you and my partner.

lines.zh: 你带着网，我认得那种线。
lines.en: You bring a net, and I know that thread.

lines.zh: 这片礁我们守了整季。
lines.en: We have held this reef for a whole season.

lines.zh: 我侧身对着你，条纹全展开。
lines.en: I turn side-on with all my bands displayed.

lines.zh: 我不逃，我先看你做什么。
lines.en: I do not flee; first I see what you do.

lines.zh: 你脚一动，我就往缝里退。
lines.en: When your foot moves, I back into the crevice.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，隔着一段距离。
lines.en: I follow you, keeping a certain distance.

lines.zh: 你游到哪，我的眼睛就到哪。
lines.en: Wherever you swim, my eyes go there too.

lines.zh: 我不靠近，只在你侧后。
lines.en: I keep off your flank, never closing in.

lines.zh: 你回头看，我停在原地。
lines.en: You look back, and I stop where I am.

lines.zh: 同伴跟着我，我们一起盯你。
lines.en: My partner follows me, and we both watch you.

lines.zh: 你身上挂着碎珊瑚，我记住了。
lines.en: Bits of coral cling to you; I have noted that.

lines.zh: 我的条纹在暗里还是亮的。
lines.en: My bands stay bright even in the dim water.

lines.zh: 我背上那条长鳍，停不住。
lines.en: That long fin on my back never stops.

lines.zh: 我不是要走，我是在数你。
lines.en: I am not leaving; I am counting you.

lines.zh: 这一片海，我认得每一道缝。
lines.en: In this sea I know every crevice.

lines.zh: 我用嘴啄你的手背。
lines.en: I peck the back of your hand with my mouth.

lines.zh: 我的嘴小，咬不深，但很准。
lines.en: My mouth is small; the bite is shallow but exact.

lines.zh: 你碰了礁，我就撞你一下。
lines.en: You touched the reef, so I ram you once.

lines.zh: 长鳍扫过你的面罩，你眨眼了。
lines.en: My streamer sweeps your mask, and you blink.

lines.zh: 我不连击，一下就走。
lines.en: I do not press; one strike and I leave.

lines.zh: 同伴在你后面，我们夹着你。
lines.en: My partner is behind you; we have you between us.

lines.zh: 这一下是为了那片断掉的珊瑚。
lines.en: That blow was for the coral you broke.

lines.zh: 你抓我，我就转过来咬。
lines.en: Grab me and I twist around to bite.

lines.zh: 水里起了白沫，我退了。
lines.en: White foam rises, and I pull back.

lines.zh: 条纹是我的旗，我举着它冲。
lines.en: My stripes are my flag; I charge with them up.

lines.zh: 我从暖水那边游进这片礁。
lines.en: I enter this reef from the warm-water side.

lines.zh: 两条一起，从第一条缝里出来。
lines.en: Two of us emerge from the first crevice.

lines.zh: 这里颜色多，我的条纹不算显眼。
lines.en: So much color here; my bands hardly stand out.

lines.zh: 我一来就找同伴。
lines.en: The first thing I do is look for my partner.

lines.zh: 礁背有阴影，我停在那里。
lines.en: There is shade behind the reef, and I settle.

lines.zh: 深温水里我们也去，只是少。
lines.en: We go to deep lukewarm water too, but rarely.

lines.zh: 我的长鳍先伸进去，身体才进。
lines.en: My streamer enters the gap before my body.

lines.zh: 这片礁还没有主人。
lines.en: This reef has no owner yet.

lines.zh: 你听见的轻响，是我转身。
lines.en: That soft sound you heard was me turning.

lines.zh: 我来了，就留下两条影子。
lines.en: I arrive, and two shadows remain.

lines.zh: 水烫起来，我的鳍卷了边。
lines.en: The water heats, and my fins curl at the edges.

lines.zh: 我掉出水面，长鳍甩在外面。
lines.en: I fall out of the water with my streamer flapping.

lines.zh: 离了水，我的薄身贴在一起。
lines.en: Out of water, my thin body sticks to itself.

lines.zh: 一声闷响，礁石全翻了。
lines.en: One dull blast, and the whole reef is overturned.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我的身体，几乎没阻力。
lines.en: An arrow passes through me with almost no resistance.

lines.zh: 光落下来，我的颜色白了。
lines.en: Light falls on me, and my colors go white.

lines.zh: 礁上没东西可挑，我瘦成一条线。
lines.en: Nothing left to pick from the reef; I thin to a line.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我僵了一瞬。
lines.en: Lightning enters the water, and I freeze for a moment.

lines.zh: 这里没有礁，只有空。
lines.en: There is no reef here, only emptiness.
